about: The machines of the relational-model line. Every rel profile names one (rel.machine); every rel stage starts by checking that the machine it runs on is that one (ci/stages/rel/common.py check_machine): the GPU's name and total memory as nvidia-smi reports them, and the CI root of the run. rel.parallel (trainings at once) may not exceed parallel_max. Owned by the coordinator (C0).

i1.note: A800 80 GB, 16-CPU quota; the GPU is shared with other users' processes; up to 5 trainings at once (round 1's batch 3, the programme lead's ruling of 2026-11-24), each within the memory margin its preflight measures

i2.note: A100 40 GB, 8-CPU quota; the GPU is shared with a vLLM service that must never be stopped: one training at a time, no GPU lease
